task: Domain implementation of counted nested pure-original forwarding
external_contract: Root owns native_callbacks.hpp/.cpp and automatic OriginalForwardFrame in nonmoved native AdmissionLease; argument-only predicates are implemented in those wrappers.
implemented: Six enum allowlist only: RegOpenKeyExA/W, CreateProcessA/W, SHGetFolderPathA/W. Only selected HookPublication profile returns true; unsupported enum/profile returns false without taking a frame.
TLS linked top frame plus cached top callback. Reservation increments original_forward_calls_ and installs admitted=false checking metadata before opaque per-hook publication proof.
Pure entry allows nesting over same-actor Full/connect wait/redirect/original/checking and pure frames, with no added SDK-only phase gate. Parent metadata stays untouched.

Every permission probe sees any current pure frame first. Only matching owner, admitted top, current thread/fiber, matching callback, positive count and unpoisoned Domain grant original_scope. General/wait/body/probe permissions remain false and CallbackThreads is not probed.

False publication rejects Warming and pops/restores parent/count/token without poison. Concurrent stop rejects Stopped with same cleanup. Publication exception poisons Domain, then restores parent/count/token. Reservation identity changes poison. Exact LIFO leave validates token owner/admitted/count/thread/fiber/callback and clears token.

Pure current frame blocks ordinary/connect admission. Connect pending/probe queries return false; mutable Original and Cooperative connect checkpoint/routing methods throw before touching suspended state. Ordinary leave aborts if called while a pure child remains current.

Forward count participates in destructor, active(), port-binding, begin(), both activation guards and pause/drain checks. Host setup complete preserves its existing Original-profile ability to observe already admitted work, matching existing connect behavior.
Existing Error RAII preserves WinLastError across entry/proof/leave/checkpoint bookkeeping. No gate spans publication, SDK, wait, provider, or PTD calls.
No private CallbackThreads enter/leave, allocation, map/fabricated-handle access, generic CRT expansion, extra wait, or constructor/factory behavior changes were added.

source_inspection.status: Reviewed source paths and declarations; no compile or project test execution.
checks: Header override signatures match root native Admission API.
All existing original_connect_calls_ quiescence guards mirror original_forward_calls_.
Try-enter owns count only after clean token/actor/control checks; catch balances that count and uses saved parent/callback.
Initial failed admission throws before native wrapper owns a true token; exact leave only for successful admission.
Normal/exceptional pop restores outer Full/connect permission computation and leaves outer callback/thread/fiber/port/counter/phase fields unchanged.
Checking frame also masks outer permission during reentrant publication proof callbacks.
Same-thread different-fiber suspended parent rejects; other actor forward frames retain separate TLS and shared count under gate.
Publication stop while already admitted does not erase successful original permission before exact leave; new entries reject closing.
Generic mutable connect APIs cannot use a pure scope to transition suspended outer phase.

edge_cases: Clean token can be reused after exact leave; dirty/already-owned token rejects. Root was informed; test author was informed.

Invalid LIFO leave, owner/callback/thread/fiber mismatch, ordinary parent leave while child active, or leaked child reservation are fatal contract violations, following existing nonthrowing leave style.
Unknown publication proof exceptions poison even if no SDK ran; this preserves the requested unknown-outcome policy. Cleanup still pops/counts current frame.
Parent frames may be checking/admitted, and separate Domains can nest on the same valid actor; scope only grants top owner. Normal native binding still supplies one Context/Domain.
Automatic token metadata is Domain-owned while admitted; external raw mutation of its parent link/fields is outside the token contract.
No claim that Windows APIs actually reenter hooks. The implementation permits the six statically proven pure-forward selections without granting shared general-body access.
